$comment: Gold-set regression for the classifier and the skill extractor. Run by `scrape verify`. Every fixed bug becomes a row here, so it can never quietly return: cross-tier titles (dental assistant != dental hygienist, physician assistant != physician), magnet synonyms, homonym skills (EMS AirFlow != Apache Airflow), boilerplate collisions. expect: null means the title must stay UNMAPPED — forcing a wrong-but-confident answer is the failure mode.
